sources.snippet: Overview stable-diffusion-v-1-4-original is a latent diffusion model for text-to-image generation developed by CompVis that generates photo-realistic images from text prompts at 512x512 resolution. The model uses a fixed CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder with cross-attention to a UNet diffusion backbone operating in the latent space of a learned autoencoder that downsamples by a factor of 8. This ...
